name: fight15-s29
title: Three players: a Ready taken back does not stop the countdown, and zero starts the match

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
combo_select ComboHostActivity Skirmish Defense
wait_combo ComboHostScene Grasslands
combo_select ComboHostScene Grasslands
setup_host_port {PORT}
combo_select ComboHostPlayers 3
activate ButtonHostOptions
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostOptions
activate TabHostPageConnection
combo_select ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
combo_select ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetVisibility Public (default)
assert_label ComboHostNetRelay Game service (default)
activate ButtonHostOptBack
wait_ms 500
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 3 90
wait_ms 1200
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Waiting for Joiner and Joiner2 to press Ready
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerStart Cancel Start
video_mark countdown-host
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/ready.json 60
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus waiting for Joiner2 to press Ready
video_mark one-ready-host
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_joiner}/cancelled.json 60
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus waiting for Joiner and Joiner2 to press Ready
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus Starting in
assert_label ButtonMultiplayerStart Cancel Start
video_mark ready-taken-back-host
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 3 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Cancel Ready
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/ready.json
video_mark ready-joiner
wait_ms 2500
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_label ButtonMultiplayerReady Ready
wait_label LabelMultiplayerStatus The host is starting the match in
assert_label LabelMultiplayerStatus press Ready
touch_file {PROBE_DIR}/cancelled.json
video_mark ready-taken-back-joiner
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
